primaryAuthority: Oregon State Police Tribal Gaming Section
scopeNotes: Oregon State Police regulates Class III activity under the state's nine tribal compacts. Current NIGC and operator evidence also identifies Ko-Kwel Casino Resort Medford as a Class II casino destination, so the physical-destination runtime scope is 10 current casinos rather than the older nine-location Class III map. Burns Paiute Tribe's Old Camp Casino remains a historical closure and is excluded. Convenience/travel-plaza gaming such as Plateau Travel Plaza is outside the destination-casino scope.
